statement: Between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-31 the Ukrainian General Staff publicly claims a strike on at least one oil refinery inside the Russian Federation, and a Russian regional governor or the Russian Ministry of Defence acknowledges a drone attack on, or fire at, that refinery or its locality on the same date.
resolution: True if, for a date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-31, the Ukrainian General Staff claims a strike on a refinery inside Russia and a Russian governor or MoD acknowledges a drone attack or fire at that refinery or its locality.
failure_condition: No date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-31 carries both a Ukrainian General Staff refinery strike claim and a matching Russian governor or MoD acknowledgment of a drone attack or fire at that refinery or its locality.

statement: US Central Command or the US Department of Defense publicly confirms a US military strike on a target located inside the territory of Iran that occurred between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15.
resolution: True if a CENTCOM or Department of Defense statement, press release, or official social media post confirms a US strike on Iranian territory dated between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15. Targets at sea do not count.
failure_condition: No US strike on Iranian territory occurs between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15, or none is confirmed by CENTCOM or the Department of Defense by the deadline.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield, FRED series DGS10, prints 5.50 percent or higher on at least one observation date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 5.05 percent on the packet date, 2026-10-15.
resolution: True if the FRED DGS10 series shows any daily value at or above 5.50 for an observation date from 2026-10-16 through 2026-12-31 inclusive. Reference level at seal: 5.05 percent.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 daily value for observation dates 2026-10-16 through 2026-12-31 is below 5.50 percent.

statement: The Nasdaq Composite index closes at or below 25,281.14, which is 5 percent below the 2026-10-15 packet reference level of 26,611.73, on at least one trading day between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if the official Nasdaq Composite closing value, per Nasdaq or FRED series NASDAQCOM, is 25,281.14 or lower on any trading day from 2026-10-16 through 2026-11-30. Reference at seal: 26,611.73.
failure_condition: Every Nasdaq Composite daily close from 2026-10-16 through 2026-11-30 is above 25,281.14.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one entry with a dateAdded between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-30 whose vendorProject or product field names Drupal, Next.js, or NGINX.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains at least one entry with dateAdded from 2026-10-16 through 2026-11-30 whose vendorProject or product value contains Drupal, Next.js, or NGINX (case-insensitive).
failure_condition: No KEV entry with dateAdded from 2026-10-16 through 2026-11-30 has a vendorProject or product value containing Drupal, Next.js, or NGINX.

statement: CISA issues at least one new Emergency Directive, published on the CISA directives page with an issue date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if the CISA directives page at cisa.gov lists an Emergency Directive (not a Binding Operational Directive or a supplemental direction to an existing ED) with an issue date from 2026-10-16 through 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: CISA issues no new Emergency Directive with an issue date from 2026-10-16 through 2026-11-30.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with an epicenter within 200 km of the epicenter of USGS event us6000u18k (the M7.7 Pitaloza Arriba, Panama event) and an origin time between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15 UTC.
resolution: True if the USGS ComCat search returns at least one event, magnitude 6.0 or higher, origin time 2026-10-16 00:00 UTC to 2026-11-15 23:59 UTC, within 200 km of the us6000u18k epicenter.
failure_condition: No USGS-cataloged earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 200 km of the us6000u18k epicenter between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-15 UTC.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of the 435 seats in the US House of Representatives in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: True if, as of the deadline, Associated Press race calls or state-certified results show Democratic candidates winning at least 218 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates win fewer than 218 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election per AP calls or state-certified results at the deadline.

statement: Edi Rama submits his resignation as Prime Minister of Albania, is dismissed, or loses a parliamentary no-confidence vote on a date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if Rama submits his resignation, is dismissed, or loses a parliamentary no-confidence vote on a date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-30, as reported by two of Reuters, AP, AFP.
failure_condition: Edi Rama neither resigns, nor is dismissed, nor loses a no-confidence vote on any date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-30.

statement: The death sentence of Nidal Hasan, the 2009 Fort Hood shooter, is carried out on a date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-12-31, as confirmed by the US Army or the US Department of Defense.
resolution: True if the US Army or Department of Defense publicly confirms that Nidal Hasan was executed on a date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: Nidal Hasan has not been executed on any date between 2026-10-16 and 2026-12-31.
